title: Entity catalog table
responsibility: Lists shell, function, config, service and model entities with columns for their category; pages and components use the shared visual card.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.category
inputs.description: Required category other than pages and components: shells, functions, configs, services or models. Determines columns and labels; only a shell is described under its name.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.rows
inputs.description: Required catalog rows in display order. Used-by text falls back to pages where no direct users exist.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation context for entity links and actions.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.verification
inputs.description: Defaults to true in catalogs; false in relationship tabs to omit verification indicators.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.lens
inputs.description: Revision-scoped screenshot evidence for linked consumers.

outputs.name: ExplorerTable
outputs.description: Catalog item using the shared Used In consumer links and screenshot previews, with navigation and captures bound to the selected revision. Other item facts and verification follow the category.
